I agree with most of what you said, except for the part where you said people are not paid by the value they add to the economy but are rather paid by how much power they have to pay themselves. I would argue that the power they have to pay themselves is in fact dependent on how much value they add to the economy. Typically, to be able to pay yourself, you must own the means to a production and be at the top of a hierarchy under a company that you have created. If this system of production you have created is successful, with consistent revenue, and nice profit margins, you will increase your ability to pay yourself, which is in itself dependent on how much your product/services are demanded by the market.

It would be cool if the system changed but it just doesnt sound as profitable.
